summary: Carphenazine Maleate received high scores for liver and heart concerns, but these numbers come from a small computer model rather than tests on people [M]. Although Carphenazine Maleate has no listed problems of its own, several chemically related drugs have shown serious safety issues [3][4][5]. For example, the related drug Pipamazine was pulled from the United States market for causing liver harm [4]. Additionally, Thioridazine was pulled worldwide for heart harm and carries warnings for infection risk, while Perphenazine carries a severe boxed warning for mental health effects [3][5].
